5.1 beta 7h: PearlCharge really boosts the pearl, AutoMace gets Stun Slam

**PearlCharge**
- Fixed: the pearl was thrown before the wind charge burst, so it never got a boost. It now flies about a third
  faster: about 50 blocks up instead of 30, or 65 blocks out at 45 degrees instead of 50. You still hop about 6 blocks.
- The Order and Delay settings are gone: only one timing boosts the pearl, so the module now always uses it.
- It tells you why when it can't launch: you need to be on the ground, and the items off cooldown.
- A pearl lands you where it lands, so aimed straight up into open sky it falls back to where you were. Aim at a
  ledge or a block above you to go higher.

**AutoMace**
- New **Stun Slam** setting, on by default. When a player's shield would stop your smash, AutoMace hits with an axe
  from your hotbar and then the mace in the same tick, so the smash goes through. It needs an axe on your hotbar and
  **Swap To Mace** on, and works on players only.
- **Skip Blocking** no longer skips a shielded target that Stun Slam can break.

Fabric only, Minecraft 26.2 and 26.3. Tested in singleplayer on 26.2 only, not on a server. With a ping of 40ms or
more the pearl boost may be less reliable, and anticheats may flag Stun Slam.
